source.provenance: Indian Revised Version (Hindi). These verses first stood here as an unverified sample typed from memory; on 2026-10-02 their wording was replaced by the distributor's own text (https://ebible.org/hin2017, pages 1JN01.htm and JHN03.htm) by scripts/verify-scripture.mjs --fix; nothing was retyped. The distributor's copyright page states the Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike licence 4.0 for this translation. A selection, not a change: the verse text is exactly the source's; the translators' footnotes, the section headings and the cross-references (the lines between verses and the references the translation sets in parentheses inside a verse) are not included. The English beside it is the World English Bible, a separate public-domain text.

sentences.text: यदि हम कहें, कि हम में कुछ भी पाप नहीं, तो अपने आपको धोखा देते हैं और हम में सत्य नहीं।
sentences.english: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth isn’t in us.

sentences.text: यदि हम अपने पापों को मान लें, तो वह हमारे पापों को क्षमा करने, और हमें सब अधर्म से शुद्ध करने में विश्वासयोग्य और धर्मी है।
sentences.english: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

sentences.text: “क्योंकि परमेश्वर ने जगत से ऐसा प्रेम रखा कि उसने अपना एकलौता पुत्र दे दिया, ताकि जो कोई उस पर विश्वास करे, वह नाश न हो, परन्तु अनन्त जीवन पाए।
sentences.english: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
